ai.headline: Very well connected spot in Ñuñoa, inside an official flood zone that needs checking
ai.summary: Chile España metro ~4 minutes away and daily services 1–3 minutes away put this point among the best-connected 4% of Santiago. The point lies inside an official PRMS flood area, the main thing to check before making an offer.
ai.overview: This is an established part of Ñuñoa on Avenida Irarrázaval, dense (12,793 people/km²) and walkable: metro, shops, health, schools and a park in under five minutes. For daily life it is among the best in Santiago (score 98), and the comuna has one of the lowest recorded violent-crime rates (1,712 per 100k). Comuna prices are high (median 3,625 UF, above 78% of comunas) and recovering after the 2022–2024 dip. The trade-off is the PRMS flood zone at the point and the noise of a main avenue (63 dBA by day). It suits people who want to live without a car and buy-to-let investors, provided the flood check comes back clean.

strengths.title: Metro and services on foot
strengths.detail: Chile España metro ~4 min, groceries ~2 min, health ~1 min; service access 100/100, better than 96% of zones.

strengths.title: Very frequent public transport
strengths.detail: 397 departures per hour in the zone, more than 93% of Santiago.

strengths.title: Low-crime comuna
strengths.detail: 1,712 violent crimes per 100k and 8.1% of households victimised, both among the lowest of the comunas.

strengths.title: Moderate air pollution and heat
strengths.detail: PM2.5 of 22.6 µg/m³ and 43 hot days a year, below most comunas.

risks.title: Inside a flood area
risks.detail: The point is inside a flood polygon of the Metropolitan Regulatory Plan (MINVU).
risks.mitigation: Ask for the certificado de informaciones previas, ask about flooding in heavy rain and check the ground-floor level and basements.

risks.title: Avenue noise
risks.detail: 63 dBA daytime noise in the zone; 14% of residents are above 55 dBA at night.
risks.mitigation: Visit at night and prefer units that do not face Irarrázaval.

risks.title: High comuna price
risks.detail: The 3,625 UF median is above 78% of comunas; sales fell from 4,300 UF (2021) to 3,468 UF (2024).
risks.mitigation: Compare with recent sales in the same building or block before offering.

value.comment: Ñuñoa's median sale is 3,625 UF, above most comunas, with a dip between 2021 and 2024 and a recovery since 2025. This unit's own price is not known: its size and condition are missing.

audiences.reason: School and park 3–4 min away, but a noisy avenue and a flood risk to check.
Easy to live without a car in a safe comuna, though prices are high.
Metro in 4 min and very frequent transit support rental demand.
Liquid market (12,391 deals), but prices are only now recovering.
Health, pharmacy and shops 1–3 min on foot.

checks: Certificado de informaciones previas (CIP) from Ñuñoa's DOM: confirm the flood zone and its conditions.
Ask the building management and neighbours about flooding in heavy rain; check basements and pumps.
Visit at night and at rush hour to judge the noise from Irarrázaval.
Compare with recent SII sales in the same block.
Check the current zoning plan for possible high-rise projects on the block.
negotiation: The official flood zone is an objective argument for a discount or better terms.
Comuna sale prices are still below the 2021 peak (4,300 UF).
